verses.text: Job again took up his parable, and said,
“As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
lines: “As God lives, who has taken away my right,
the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

verses.text: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
lines: (for the length of my life is still in me,
and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

verses.text: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
lines: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness,
neither will my tongue utter deceit.

verses.text: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
lines: Far be it from me that I should justify you.
Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

verses.text: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
lines: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go.
My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

verses.text: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
lines: “Let my enemy be as the wicked.
Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

verses.text: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
lines: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

verses.text: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
lines: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

verses.text: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
lines: Will he delight himself in the Almighty,
and call on God at all times?

verses.text: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
lines: I will teach you about the hand of God.
I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

verses.text: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
lines: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves;
why then have you become altogether vain?

verses.text: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
lines: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God,
the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

verses.text: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
lines: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword.
His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

verses.text: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.
lines: Those who remain of him will be buried in death.
His widows will make no lamentation.

verses.text: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
lines: Though he heap up silver as the dust,
and prepare clothing as the clay;

verses.text: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
lines: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on,
and the innocent will divide the silver.

verses.text: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
lines: He builds his house as the moth,
as a booth which the watchman makes.

verses.text: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
lines: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again.
He opens his eyes, and he is not.

verses.text: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
lines: Terrors overtake him like waters.
A storm steals him away in the night.

verses.text: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
lines: The east wind carries him away, and he departs.
It sweeps him out of his place.

verses.text: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
lines: For it hurls at him, and does not spare,
as he flees away from his hand.

verses.text: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
lines: Men will clap their hands at him,
and will hiss him out of his place.
